The Brahmaputra, Irrawaddy and Mekong Rivers 
originate in Tibet narrow and flow in parallel mountain 
ranges in their upper reaches. Of these rivers, 
Brahmaputra makes a “U” turn in its course to flow 
into India. This “U” turn is due to ?
questions.question_hi:
[भारत का भूगोल: अपवाह तंत्र — नदियाँ, झीलें एवं जलप्रपात • I.A.S. (Pre) 2011]

originate in Tibet narrow and flow in parallel mountain 
ranges in their upper reaches. Of these rivers, 
Brahmaputra makes a “U” turn in its course to flow 
into India. This “U” turn is due to ?
options_en: Syntaxial bending of geologically young Himalayas.

Geo-tectonic disturbance in the tertiary folded 
mountain chains.
options_hi: Syntaxial bending of geologically young Himalayas.

Geo-tectonic disturbance in the tertiary folded 
mountain chains.
questions.explanation_en:
The Himalayan mountain on their western and eastern 
extremities are sharply bend southward in deep knee-bend 
flexures that are called syntaxial bends. Almost hairpin bend 
occurs on the eastern limit of Arunachal Pradesh, where the 
mountain changes sharply from the easterly to southerly trend.

mountain changes sharply from the easterly to southerly trend.

questions.question_en:
Consider the following statements :
 1. India does not have any deposits of Thorium.
 2. Kerala's monazite sands contain Uranium. 
 Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
[भारत का भूगोल: खनिज संसाधन एवं ऊर्जा क्षेत्र • I.A.S. (Pre) 2009]
Consider the following statements :
 1. India does not have any deposits of Thorium.
 2. Kerala's monazite sands contain Uranium. 
 Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_en:
Monazite is an important ore for thorium, lanthanum, 
uranium and cerium. It is often found in coastal areas of 
Kerala in large quantities. India, Madagascar, and South 
Africa have large deposits of monazite sands. The deposits 
in India are particularly rich in monazite. Thus, statement 1 
is wrong but 2 is correct.
questions.explanation_hi:

uranium and cerium. It is often found in coastal areas of 
Kerala in large quantities. India, Madagascar, and South 
Africa have large deposits of monazite sands. The deposits 
in India are particularly rich in monazite. Thus, statement 1 
is wrong but 2 is correct.

Sharda Tributary Command Development Project ?
 Select the correct answer using the code given below:
 1. To increase agriculture production
 2. To change the format of land use by multiple crop 
cultivation.
 3. Reforms of land management.
 Code :
questions.question_hi:
[भारत का भूगोल: मृदा, प्राकृतिक वनस्पति, सिंचाई एवं बहुउद्देशीय परियोजनाएँ • U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2008 | U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2002 | U.P.U.D.A./L.D.A. (Pre)  2001]
Which of the following is/are the main objectives of 
Sharda Tributary Command Development Project ?
 Select the correct answer using the code given below:
 1. To increase agriculture production
 2. To change the format of land use by multiple crop 
cultivation.
 3. Reforms of land management.
 Code :
questions.explanation_en:
The Government of India initiated a centrally sponsored 
Command Area Development Programme (CADP) in 
December 1974 to improve irrigation potential utilisation and 
optimise agricultural production from irrigated land through 
the integrated and coordinated approach of eﬃ cient water 
management. In tune with objectives of the programme, a 
number of components such as construction of field channels 
and field drain, enforcement of warabandi, land levelling
and shaping, realignment of field boundaries/ consolidation 
of holdings, introduction of suitable cropping patterns, 
strengthening of extension services etc. were included in 
the programme and three projects were launched: (1) Sharda 
tributary (2) Ramganga & (3) Gandak. Thus, all three 
statements mentioned in the question are true. Hence, option 
(d) is the correct answer.
questions.explanation_hi:

mts) in the world. The Aral Sea is a salt water lake located on 
the border of Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan. Lake Michigan is 
one of the five main lakes of North America.

questions.explanation_en:
Amazon is the longest river in South America. This river is 
about 6437 km long. Ships can sail up to 1,600 km distance. 
Apart from this, Nile (6,695 km) of Africa, Mississippi (3779 
km) of U.S.A., and the river Ganga (2,525 km) of India are the 
prominent rivers. In terms of length the Nile river is the longest 
river in the world. Countries like South Sudan, D.R. Congo, 
Ethiopia, Eritrea, Kenya, Rawanda, Tanzania, Uganda, Burundi, 
Sudan and Egypt are the part of Drainage basin of the Nile river. 
Nile river, falls into the Mediterranean Sea.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
options_en: Statement I is correct, but Statement II is incorrect
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
Statement I is incorrect, but Statement II is correct
Neither Statement I nor Statement II is correct

Statement I is incorrect, but Statement II is correct
Neither Statement I nor Statement II is correct

[General Science • UPPCS Prelims • 2023 • GS-I]
Blue Baby Syndrome (Methemoglobinemia) in infants is caused by drinking groundwater contaminated with an excess concentration of:
questions.explanation_en: Excess nitrate (NO3⁻ > 45 mg/L) in drinking water is reduced to nitrite in an infant's gut, oxidizing hemoglobin (Fe²⁺) to methemoglobin (Fe³⁺), which cannot transport oxygen (Blue Baby Syndrome).
questions.explanation_hi:
आधिकारिक व्याख्या (UPPCS Prelims • 2023 • GS-I):
Excess nitrate (NO3⁻ > 45 mg/L) in drinking water is reduced to nitrite in an infant's gut, oxidizing hemoglobin (Fe²⁺) to methemoglobin (Fe³⁺), which cannot transport oxygen (Blue Baby Syndrome).

questions.question_en: Dudhwa National Park, the only National Park in Uttar Pradesh (part of the Dudhwa Tiger Reserve along with Kishanpur and Katarniaghat Wildlife Sanctuaries), is located in which district of UP?
questions.question_hi:
[Uttar Pradesh Special GK • UPPCS Prelims • 2023 • GS-I]
Dudhwa National Park, the only National Park in Uttar Pradesh (part of the Dudhwa Tiger Reserve along with Kishanpur and Katarniaghat Wildlife Sanctuaries), is located in which district of UP?
questions.explanation_en: Dudhwa National Park (established as a wildlife sanctuary in 1958 for swamp deer/barasingha and declared a National Park in 1977) is located in the Terai belt of Lakhimpur Kheri district, Uttar Pradesh.
questions.explanation_hi:

Dudhwa National Park (established as a wildlife sanctuary in 1958 for swamp deer/barasingha and declared a National Park in 1977) is located in the Terai belt of Lakhimpur Kheri district, Uttar Pradesh.

According to the Census of India 2011, which district of Uttar Pradesh has the HIGHEST population and which district has the HIGHEST literacy rate, respectively?
options_en: Prayagraj (Allahabad) has the highest population, and Gautam Buddha Nagar has the highest literacy rate
Lucknow has the highest population, and Kanpur Nagar has the highest literacy rate
Ghaziabad has the highest population, and Prayagraj has the highest literacy rate

questions.question_en: Which district of Uttar Pradesh is the southernmost district sharing borders with FOUR states — Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, and Bihar?
questions.question_hi:
[Uttar Pradesh Special GK • UPPCS Prelims • 2023 • GS-I]
Which district of Uttar Pradesh is the southernmost district sharing borders with FOUR states — Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, and Bihar?
questions.explanation_en: Sonbhadra is the only district in India that borders four states (MP to the west, Chhattisgarh to the south, Jharkhand to the southeast, and Bihar to the northeast). Lalitpur is surrounded on three sides by MP, Saharanpur is the northernmost, and Ballia is the easternmost district of UP.
questions.explanation_hi:
आधिकारिक व्याख्या (UPPCS Prelims • 2023 • GS-I):
Sonbhadra is the only district in India that borders four states (MP to the west, Chhattisgarh to the south, Jharkhand to the southeast, and Bihar to the northeast). Lalitpur is surrounded on three sides by MP, Saharanpur is the northernmost, and Ballia is the easternmost district of UP.

questions.question_en: The 'Montreal Protocol' (signed on 16 September 1987 under the Vienna Convention) and its 'Kigali Amendment' (2016) are binding international treaties aimed at:
questions.question_hi:
[Environment & Ecology • UPPCS Prelims • 2023 • GS-I]
The 'Montreal Protocol' (signed on 16 September 1987 under the Vienna Convention) and its 'Kigali Amendment' (2016) are binding international treaties aimed at:
options_en: Phasing out Ozone Depleting Substances (CFCs/Halons) and hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs) to protect the stratospheric ozone layer and climate
Regulating transboundary movement of hazardous wastes (Basel Convention)
Protecting wetlands of international importance (Ramsar Convention)
Conserving migratory species of wild animals (Bonn Convention)
options_hi: Phasing out Ozone Depleting Substances (CFCs/Halons) and hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs) to protect the stratospheric ozone layer and climate
Regulating transboundary movement of hazardous wastes (Basel Convention)
Protecting wetlands of international importance (Ramsar Convention)
Conserving migratory species of wild animals (Bonn Convention)
questions.explanation_en: The Montreal Protocol (1987) phases out Ozone Depleting Substances (ODS), and its Kigali Amendment (2016) phases down high-GWP hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs).
questions.explanation_hi:
आधिकारिक व्याख्या (UPPCS Prelims • 2023 • GS-I):
The Montreal Protocol (1987) phases out Ozone Depleting Substances (ODS), and its Kigali Amendment (2016) phases down high-GWP hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs).

questions.question_en: ISRO's historic Chandrayaan-3 Lander ('Vikram') and Rover ('Pragyan') successfully achieved a soft landing near the Lunar South Pole (~69.37° S, 32.32° E) on 23 August 2023. What official name was given to the landing site, and how is 23 August celebrated annually in India?
questions.question_hi:
[Space & Science Technology • UPPCS Prelims • 2024 • GS-I]
ISRO's historic Chandrayaan-3 Lander ('Vikram') and Rover ('Pragyan') successfully achieved a soft landing near the Lunar South Pole (~69.37° S, 32.32° E) on 23 August 2023. What official name was given to the landing site, and how is 23 August celebrated annually in India?
options_en: Landing site: 'Shiv Shakti Point'; celebrated as 'National Space Day'
Landing site: 'Tiranga Point'; celebrated as 'National Science Day'
Landing site: 'Jawahar Point'; celebrated as 'Aryabhata Day'
Landing site: 'Sarabhai Crater'; celebrated as 'Gaganyaan Day'
options_hi: Landing site: 'Shiv Shakti Point'; celebrated as 'National Space Day'
Landing site: 'Tiranga Point'; celebrated as 'National Science Day'
Landing site: 'Jawahar Point'; celebrated as 'Aryabhata Day'
Landing site: 'Sarabhai Crater'; celebrated as 'Gaganyaan Day'
questions.explanation_en: The Chandrayaan-3 landing site was named 'Shiv Shakti Point' (while the Chandrayaan-2 crash site was named 'Tiranga Point'), and 23 August was declared 'National Space Day'.
questions.explanation_hi:
आधिकारिक व्याख्या (UPPCS Prelims • 2024 • GS-I):
The Chandrayaan-3 landing site was named 'Shiv Shakti Point' (while the Chandrayaan-2 crash site was named 'Tiranga Point'), and 23 August was declared 'National Space Day'.
